newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen says SEC filing updates paperwork.
newsitem.headline: Loewen says SEC filing updates paperwork.

text.p: The Loewen Group Inc said Thursday that shelf registrations at the Securities and Exchange Commission were updates of previous filings and did not represent new stock offerings.
The funeral company filed for an offering of five million shares itself and the sale of 1.2 million shares by shareholders.

A Loewen spokesman said the filings were updated versions of shelf registrations made by the company in August in the same amount. The new filings reflect a hostile takeover bid for the company by Service Corp International.
A Loewen spokesman said the company has issued about 200,000 of the five million shares. The shares would be issued in connection with acquisitions.
The registration statements were necessary so the shares can be resold on the open market.

About a million of the shares registered for sale by shareholders were issued by Loewen to Provident American Corp to settle a lawsuit earlier this year. The other shares are held by Honorine and John Flanagan after Loewen purchased their business. Honorine Flanagan said the couple has no intention to sell.
